_provenance.source: ERCOT 60-Day SCED Disclosure Gen Resource Data (NP3-965), full-year publication-month corpus, rows filtered to delivery year (~60-day publication lag; validation-holdout 2022 and locked-test 2026 rows in adjacent publication files excluded from training years). Per-year basis: 2024/2025 from the 2026-07-21 full-corpus intake (2024-05 sparse; 2025 Nov partial / Dec absent — disclosed in coverage); 2022 (validation-holdout, data-only) from the post-purge partial slice; 2023 refreshed 2026-08-03 (ercot-157) from the complete delivery-2023 re-upload under data/raw/ercot/SCED/ (315 shards, all 365 delivery days)
_provenance.method: per-interval Base Point -> HASL segments of the SCED2 (as-dispatched) offer curve of ON-status merchant gas (the energy-dispatchable online spare, net of AS responsibility), MW-weighted quantile ladder of segment prices as effective-HR multipliers (price / HH-daily+ERCOT-basis gas), derived within net-load-percentile bins
_provenance.driver: system net-load percentile within year (EIA-930 demand - wind - solar), forward-native (a forecast year's bins regenerate from its own load+VRE)
_provenance.year_scoped: NO pooled fallback by design (rule 13): the SCED corpus is scoped sample days and the RT offer surface is regime-bound — a year absent from this artifact gets NO RT wall (the DAM basis is retained); a 2024/2025-derived ladder is barred from 2023's post-Uri conservative-operations regime
_provenance.frozen: rule 23 — re-derive only on a SCED disclosure source-data update, never because a residual moved
_provenance.ercot105_added: 2022 (validation-holdout, data-only) + 2023 RT SCED wall added from re-uploaded corpus (pub 2022-01..2023-12; 2023 delivery Jan-Oct, summer scarcity covered); 2024/2025 ladders+coverage byte-identical to main
_provenance.ercot157_refreshed: 2023 CC/CT blocks re-derived 2026-08-03 from the complete delivery-2023 corpus re-upload (data/raw/ercot/SCED/, ERCOT-151 §4 ask 1): the prior 2023 block's source slice ended at publication 2023-12, covering deliveries Jan-Oct 2023 only (see ercot105_added) — Nov-Dec 2023 deliveries enter the 2023 wall for the first time (intervals 28,315 -> 35,038; upper net-load bins 5-6 byte-identical, matching the 2026-07-21 full-corpus verification of 8751 intervals/bin). 2022/2024/2025 blocks byte-identical.

positiontail.statistic: per (class, year, bin): the MW-weighted empirical quantile function of the SAME spare-segment multiplier population the frozen ladder measured, at its own distinct step points above the p90 grid point (lib/positiontail.tail_support; multipliers HCAP-clipped by the parent segment construction, round(3); x = cumulative-MW fraction, round(6), strictly increasing). Sub-p90 ladders are the frozen artifact's blocks byte-verbatim; an empty tail keeps the frozen p90 end-clamp byte-identical (zero-support rule)
